previousRule: independent-di-acceptance-v1 requires resolution of every Critical/Major across its full accepted scope.
newRule: independent-di-acceptance-v2 adds quarantined-partial-universe-v1. Only ticker-isolated evidence blockers can remain OPEN Major, with exact register/provenance/triggers and technical exclusion. All unresolved Critical and shared-system blockers remain global; every other DI gate remains required.
reason: Retain honest full-universe reporting without fabricated evidence or reopening concrete unavailable-source/definition blockers.
compatibility: Additive versioned files. No old contract bytes, hashes, registry releases, accounting facts or historical snapshots are rewritten. Legacy v1 readers remain strict. New production Policy B must use the explicit server-only factory and pinned current acceptance, never a legacy v1 service as a partial-release substitute.
databaseMigration: Not required; existing append-only acceptance JSON and body hashes support versioned bodies.
independentReview: DI14 is not supplied by Owner policy approval; exact new body/partition/source ledger must have trusted independent review capability before insertion/use.
